description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a Saproling creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Saproling Burst
uses.cardState: with a fade counter on it
